mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT rule_version_id FROM sn_item WHERE seq_pi_no = #{pi} ORDER BY rule_version_id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM sn_item i LIMIT #{cap}) c
SELECT i.status, COUNT(*) n FROM sn_item i GROUP BY i.status
SELECT bill_no, pi, org_code FROM sn_bill_ledger WHERE bill_no IN #{b}
SELECT DISTINCT bill_no, pi FROM sn_prd_mo WHERE bill_no IN #{b}

SELECT i.id, i.sn, i.rule_version_id, i.seq_dec, i.seq_pi_no, COALESCE(i.factory_code, NULLIF(bl.org_code, '')) factory_code, COALESCE(f.factory_name, NULLIF(bl.org_name, '')) factory_name, i.customer_code, i.pi_no, i.bill_no, i.bill_seq, i.material_code, i.attach_no, i.length_text, i.status, i.delivery_mode, i.delivery_batch_no FROM sn_item i LEFT JOIN sn_bill_ledger bl ON i.factory_code IS NULL AND bl.bill_no = i.bill_no LEFT JOIN sn_factory f ON f.factory_code = COALESCE(i.factory_code, bl.org_code) AND i.id > #{last} ORDER BY i.id LIMIT #{limit}
